field.label: Group enabled
field.help: Disabled groups do not grant access and do not create speed limits.

field.label: Group name
field.help: Use a name that is clear to an operator, for example “Office”, “Guests”, or “No internet”.

field.label: Description
field.help: Optional note about who belongs to this group and why.

field.label: Internet access
field.help: Allow lets enabled clients use the selected destinations. Block denies that traffic.

field.label: Speed limit
field.help: Choose no limit, a separate limit for every client, or one shared limit for the whole group.

field.label: Download limit
field.help: Maximum speed from the internet to clients in this group.

field.label: Upload limit
field.help: Maximum speed from clients in this group to the internet.

field.label: Schedule
field.help: Optional OPNsense firewall schedule. Leave empty when the group must work all the time.

field.label: Maximum open connections
field.help: Advanced protection. Zero means no separate limit for this group.

field.label: Maximum TCP connections
field.help: Advanced protection. Zero means no separate TCP limit.

field.label: New TCP connections
field.help: Maximum number of new TCP connections during the interval below. Zero disables this limit.

field.label: TCP interval, seconds
field.help: Time window for the new TCP connection limit.

field.label: Packets per interval
field.help: Maximum number of packets during the interval below. Zero disables this limit.

field.label: Packet interval, seconds
field.help: Time window for the packet limit.
